(a) No precedent (RQ1), all four agents: 360/360 pass; default chosen 359/360 (Sonnet 14/15 on dispatch). (b) Repository precedent, all agents: all endpoints opposite default -> follow precedent 359/360; local support pooled 0% / 21% / 49% / 96% at 0-3/3; sibling-only adoption Sonnet 6/269, Opus 0/270, gpt-5.6-sol 2/270, gpt-6-sol 5/270. (c) No guidance C0 (baseline) + Sonnet / gpt-6-sol: joint success 0/15 in all four settings. Does not work. (d) Written rule in task (C1) + Claude Code + Sonnet-4-6: ID 15/15, envelope 15/15. Works; cost Not stated. (e) C1 + Codex + gpt-6-sol: ID 14/15, envelope 15/15. Works; cost Not stated. (f) Code example only (C2) + Sonnet-4-6: ID 0/15, envelope 8/15. Does not work / partly. (g) C2 + gpt-6-sol: 15/15, 15/15. Works. (h) Rule + example (C3) + Sonnet and gpt-6-sol: 15/15 each setting. Works. (i) Rule in native file (CLAUDE.md) + Claude Code + Sonnet-4-6: 15/15 both pairs (controlled); open-source envelope 57/60 (vs 0/60 without). Works. (j) Rule in native file (AGENTS.md) + Codex + gpt-6-sol: 15/15 both pairs; open-source 60/60 (vs 0/60). Works. Open-source error handling (no guidance): local pattern followed in 945/945 classifiable successes; task success Sonnet 228/240, Opus 240/240, gpt-5.6-sol 240/240, gpt-6-sol 240/240. Guidance cost functional success in 2 of 240 runs only

Tasks: one new endpoint in a purpose-built Flask API; 6 implementation pairs with two functionally equivalent alternatives; open-source validation in 4 repos. Configurations: 4 agents x precedent conditions (zero precedent; 8 support-level conditions; file placements) and guidance conditions C0-C3 and rule delivery (none/task/native file) for 2 agents x 2 pairs. Baseline: zero precedent (RQ1) and C0 no guidance (RQ4). Held constant: functional task and hidden tests; only guidance varied. Acceptance tests: hidden tests accepting either implementation. Repetitions: 15 independent sessions per cell on fresh repository copies. Human intervention: none. Stats: exact binomial CIs, Cochran-Armitage, Fisher, Monte Carlo randomization tests with Holm, Mantel-Haenszel, block bootstrap, Newcombe intervals

Written rule 59/60 joint successes vs code example 38/60 vs none 0/60 (C1 vs C0 Holm p <= 0.00159; C3 vs C1 p = 1). Rule in task description 60/60 = native file 60/60 (cannot show equivalence; difference up to ~6 points compatible). Open-source native-file rule 117/120 vs 0/120 (each stratum Holm p = 4.9e-4). Local vs sibling precedent: 347/360 vs 13/360 at 3/3; placement shifts 0/15 -> 15/15 (gpt-6-sol ID, Holm p <= 6e-5) and 0/15 -> 11/15 (Sonnet casing); Opus no placement effect (p = 0.148)

Yes: distinguished guidance conditions and precedent locations with significant tests; repeatable (15 sessions per cell, outcomes near deterministic). Limitations stated: rule-delivery channels at ceiling (equivalence not shown); local-sibling confounds relatedness and location; count and file assignment confounded in support levels; zero-precedent and precedent conditions under different execution settings; retries and reruns; agent = model + harness

One Flask task family in the controlled study; open-source study covers two implementation choices (guidance for one); support-level and placement effects untested beyond controlled repo; agents from two providers; classifiers capture selected patterns, not maintainability; native-file experiments test harness-loaded rules, not autonomous discovery. Gap: design-decision traceability preserving rationale and priorities
